Weighing about 800 grams, it can walk, sit, kick a ball, and grasp objects out of the box, and can even get back up on its own after falling. More importantly, it is not just a moving toy, but an open-source robotics platform for developers: users can train action policies in simulation and then deploy them to the real robot. This "little duck" has attracted attention not only because it is adorable and affordable enough, and not just because robots have finally begun to land on ordinary developers' desks. The real signal it sends is that AI is moving from models inside screens to physical devices that can perceive, act, and interact. In the past few years, when people talked about AI, the conversation mostly centered on cloud-based large models, parameter scale, training clusters, and computing centers. excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, un pato robótico de solo 25 centímetros de alto ha puesto inesperadamente el foco sobre la imaginación de la IA en el edge. On September 4, IFA 2026 will open at the Berlin Exhibition Grounds in Germany. As one of the world's largest consumer electronics and home appliance trade shows, IFA attracts over 1,900 exhibitors showcasing cutting-edge technologies and products ranging from robotics, AI, and smart home to flying cars. At the pre-show event, IFA CEO Leif Lindner predicted that AI will be deeply woven into the fabric of this year's expo. He noted that previous IFAs featured dedicated AI zones to accommodate related companies and products, but today AI has evolved from a niche category into the infrastructure underpinning the entire consumer electronics industry, integrated into nearly every product segment.

Anker has also recognized this transformation AI is bringing to consumer electronics. On September 3, ahead of the official opening of IFA, Anker held a global press conference announcing that its five brands (Anker, Anker SOLIX, eufy, eufyMake, and soundcore) would be consolidated under the single "Anker" brand. Anker's brand strategy upgrade aligns with broader industry trends: as AI, on-device computing, robotics, and IoT technologies advance, category boundaries are becoming increasingly blurred. This is not just an internal restructuring of Anker's brand architecture, but also a move to significantly reduce consumers' cognitive burden—users will only need to recognize one Anker brand to enjoy a seamless, end-to-end smart experience. "In an era when categories stood apart, building category brands made sense. But today, a new era has arrived."

En el acto de presentación de la feria, el consejero delegado de la IFA, Leif Lindner, anticipó que la IA impregnará la base misma de la edición de este año. Señaló que en años anteriores la IFA contaba con una zona de IA independiente para albergar a las empresas y productos del sector; sin embargo, hoy la IA ha pasado de ser una categoría específica a convertirse en la infraestructura que sustenta toda la industria de la electrónica de consumo, integrándose en casi todas las categorías.

items.title: 26g 无边框带扬声器，加南打造面向日常的屏显 AI 眼镜
items.raw_excerpt: 多数屏显 AI 眼镜，总要在重量、外观、音频体验之间做出取舍。 加南全新研发的带显示 AI 眼镜，把 26g 无感佩戴、无边框形态与内置扬声器融为一体。智能显示不再是显眼的科技装置，而是回归一副日常眼镜的模样。 AI 眼镜，应当首先是一副适合日常佩戴的眼镜。 自 K2 开始，加南始终坚持，智能眼镜不该是笨重的科技外设。它需要拥有普通眼镜的佩戴体验，能够陪伴用户完整的日常生活。今天，我们带来正在推进的全新带显示 AI 眼镜研发预告，将对全天候智能佩戴的思考，融入一副接近传统眼镜的产品形态。 全新产品采用创新无边框框型设计，脱离行业常规的金属边框方案。去掉厚重前框结构，外观高度贴近普通光学眼镜，支持近视配镜。无论是通勤出行还是办公室工作，都可以自然佩戴，消解智能硬件的突兀感。为实现这套形态，我们协同浙江通达光学有限公司，完成结构强度与量产可行性的多重验证，把设计构想落地为可量产的产品方案。 整机重量控制在 26g。 过重压鼻、久戴酸胀，是屏显类智能眼镜普遍存在的痛点。我们把整机重量做到接近普通眼镜水准，大幅降低面部佩戴负担，实现全天候长时间舒适佩戴。 设备内置扬声器单元。作为带显示 AI 眼镜，无需额外搭配耳机，音频播放、语音交互、系统提示均可由眼镜直接发声输出，在获取声音信息的同时保留对外界环境的感知，屏显视听一体化，体验更完整。 镜腿厚度做到 2.3 毫米，控制在 2.5 毫米以内。 这是目前行业内极窄的镜腿规格。极致收窄的镜腿，不止是外观上的精简，更让这副眼镜在视觉上和普通眼镜几乎没有区别，佩戴之后不会产生强烈的设备感。 搭载 PPG 心率检测模块，持续采集心跳数据。系统记录心率变化，基于心率波动感知用户状态，将情绪状态以表情包形式呈现在眼镜显示区域。同时眼镜可以主动感知用户状态，给出 AI 提示。当监测到心率出现紧急异常状况，设备将触发急救相关机制，提供安全防护。 采用

title_i18n.es: Los datos de sueño analizados por IA podrían proporcionar una alerta temprana de una semana sobre la gripe y la COVID-19.

excerpt_i18n.en: UKHSA study finds sleep app cough data can detect respiratory illness and signal outbreaks early.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 英国卫生安全局研究发现，睡眠应用记录的咳嗽数据可检测呼吸道疾病，并提前预警疫情暴发。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un estudio de la UKHSA concluye que los datos de tos de una aplicación de sueño pueden detectar enfermedades respiratorias y señalar brotes de forma temprana.

items.title: Go grandmaster Shin defeats AI KataGo with a two-stone handicap
items.raw_excerpt: Go grandmaster Shin reportedly defeated the AI program KataGo in a two-stone handicap match, highlighting human strategic resilience against AI under certain conditions.

title_i18n.en: Go grandmaster Shin defeats AI KataGo with a two-stone handicap
title_i18n.zh: 围棋大师申在让两子 handicap 的比赛中击败人工智能 KataGo。
title_i18n.es: El gran maestro de Go Shin derrota a la IA KataGo con un hándicap de dos piedras.

excerpt_i18n.en: Go grandmaster Shin reportedly defeated the AI program KataGo in a two-stone handicap match, highlighting human strategic resilience against AI under certain conditions.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 据报道，围棋大师申在让两子的对局中击败了人工智能程序KataGo。这一结果引发了对围棋AI能力边界及人类棋手策略的讨论。尽管细节有限，但事件表明顶级人类选手在特定条件下仍可对AI构成挑战。
